title: K-flat representative of the augmented derived reduction tower
statement: Fix l,E,X,D as in [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Give each fixed derived scalar extension F_n its tensor--restriction adjunction adj_n [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction], normalized on every K-flat complex P so that its unit followed by normalizedDVRKFlatComparison equals the localized integralTowerUnit. Every completed-coefficient derived object M admits a K-flat representative e:Q(P)~M and isomorphisms a_n:Res_n(F_n M)~Q(Res_n(B_n tensor P)), identifying the units with e.inv followed by the localized canonical tensor unit. These isomorphisms intertwine the adjoint derived quotient transitions with the localized integralTowerTransition [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower].

proof.text: Choose a complex G representing M and a K-flat resolution q:P->G. Its localization followed by the representative isomorphism gives e:Q(P)~M.

proof.text: The scalar-extension counit is invertible on P. Restrict it and compose with exact-restriction localization to obtain an isomorphism c_n. Define a_n as restriction of F_n(e.inv) followed by c_n. Naturality of the adjunction unit and the assumed K-flat unit normalization prove the augmentation equation.

proof.text: Apply the K-flat quotient-transition identity with e and the normalized adjunctions. Its explicit comparison maps are exactly a_n. Reassociation gives the transition equation.

theorem normalizedDVR_kflat_reduction_model
    (adj : ∀ n : ℕ, scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n ⊣
      scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X n)
    (hunit : ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P →
      (adj n).unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ normalizedDVRKFlatComparison l E X n P =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (integralTowerUnit l E X D hl P n))
    (M : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E X D hl) :
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P ∧
      ∃ (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ M)
        (a : ∀ n : ℕ,
          (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X n).obj
              ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj M) ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj (unrestrictedTowerComplex l E X n P)),
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (adj n).unit.app M ≫
            (a n).hom = e.inv ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (integralTowerUnit l E X D hl P n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X (n + 1)).map
            (((adj (n + 1)).homEquiv
              M ((normalizedDVRRes l E X n.le_succ).obj
                ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj M))).symm
              ((adj n).unit.app M ≫
                (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp l E X D hl n.le_succ).inv.app
                  ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj M))) ≫
          (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp l E X D hl n.le_succ).hom.app
            ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj M) ≫ (a n).hom =
        (a (n + 1)).hom ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (integralTowerTransition l E X D hl P n))
